subject: MAXESS Master Engineering + Design Directive V2

human.summary: MAXESS V2 locks the rebuild around one authoritative assessment machine, one state authority, one scoring authority, one validated result contract, and E01-E09 as deterministic Results consumers. Legacy E00 variants are source material, not sacred architecture. The flagship AI Score remains the golden reference, while the same machine is designed to grow into a deterministic knowledge-driven assessment platform for supported AI-and-life topics.

naya.summary: Execute V2 as the canonical MAXESS architecture/design standard. Inventory before major changes; unify authority; eliminate timing-dependent handoffs, duplicate scoring, DOM scraping, and competing state; preserve proven behavior; verify every gate; maintain green/yellow/red truth; issue human-readable receipt and next execution after each meaningful cycle.

decisions: V2 supersedes V1 for active execution while V1 remains preserved lineage.
Do not default to isolated E00/E00.xx patches.
E00 is authoritative assessment runtime; E01-E09 are canonical Results consumers.
MAXESS_RESULT_V1 is the authoritative result interface unless deliberately versioned.
AI Score is the golden regression/reference assessment.
Dynamic assessment compilation should use structured knowledge and deterministic rules without a mandatory paid runtime LLM API.
MAXESS must optimize for usefulness, honesty, learning, beauty, speed, accessibility, resilience, and evidence.
Green means implemented and verified by evidence; code existence alone is never green.
Meaningful executions must preserve human-readable continuity, AI handoff, receipt, current state, and next execution.

evidence: Naya Power canonical repository was located and read.
Existing MAXESS V1 directive was read.
Existing MAXESS execution log was read.
Existing E00/E00.xx and E01-E09 source lineage was confirmed in repository tree.
V2 directive was committed to the canonical MAXESS project directory.
